newsitem.title: UK: UK's Ofwat calls for cut in water bills - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: UK's Ofwat calls for cut in water bills - newspaper.

text.p: Ofwat, Britain's water industry watchdog, is calling for a cut of up to 50 stg from an average households' water bill as a condition of allowing the bid battle for South West Water to proceed, said the Observer newspaper.
Two rival bids for South West Water from Severn Trent Plc and Wessex Water Plc are currently being considered by the Monopolies and Mergers Commission, Britian's competition authority.
The Observer quoted one unnamed source close to the MMC inquiry as saying the head of Ofwat, Ian Byatt, has asked for price cuts of up to 20 percent over the next five years.

"These demands are thought to have shocked the two bidders. They believe that such price cuts are impossible to achieve and have vowed to walk away from the contest if they are imposed," said the article.
